gripOrHq.title: Shredder Uplink Protocol
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Make a run on the Archives. If run is successful, do not access cards from the Archives; instead, treat run as a successful run on HQ.

gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

heapOrArchives.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

rig.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
rig.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Audit of Call Records
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted two or more runs during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

root.title: Scorched Earth
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 4 meat damage.
